INT_BATCH007_T.statement: commit_sha is null in this blob; authoritative binding is in the dispatch_queue archive field after the commit lands.

anti_tuning_note: Calibrating thresholds on measured data is a known hazard and ATS-1 is the structural answer, not an assurance. The rule precedes the measurement; the calibration arm never sees real data; the calibration is declared non-evidential about H-EQD-001, HEUR-DS-1 and H-SMTH-001 in either direction; only substitution of measured numbers into the frozen form is admitted, and any other change is a versioned amendment that resets confirmatory status to exploratory_only; the driver including its unexecuted real-arm entry point is hash-bound at TASK-20260801-022 and the real arm must run the identical file.
authorization_basis: Both gate conditions verified against the committed tree before this determination. (1) The contract contains THR-EQD-1, CERT-EQD-1, CAL-STOP-1 and ATS-1 in full. (2) The tree contains NO run artifact of any kind for EXP-EQD-001 - experiments/EXP-EQD-001 holds specification.yaml and nothing else.
calibration_authorization_scope: AUTHORIZES ONLY the non-evidential calibration run RUN-EQD-001-calib on the NULL AND PLANTED objects, and AUTHORIZES NOTHING ABOUT THE REAL ARM. RUN-EQD-001-real remains gated on TASK-20260801-026 recording APPROVAL_DETERMINATION APPROVED after the reading rule is frozen at TASK-20260801-023 and independently reviewed at TASK-20260801-025. No half-tuple of the deterministic factor base may be enumerated under this authorization.
preregistration_binding: This commit hash-binds the THRESHOLD RULE before the calibration that will supply its numbers. ATS-1 clause 1 dates the freeze to this commit. The calibration therefore supplies a NUMBER and never a CHOICE: THR-EQD-1, CERT-EQD-1, CAL-STOP-1, the statistic family, the resolution ladder, the binning rule, the plant construction and the delta ladder are all fixed here, before any datum exists.
relation_to_heur_ds_1: Equidistribution of the fibre invariants is a LOAD-BEARING INPUT to HEUR-DS-1 and is NOT identical to it. This experiment measures no smoothness, factors no integer and computes no largest prime factor. A smoothness measurement remains OWED and is not discharged by this batch.
scope_three_limbs: L1 - that (e_1,e_2) is NOT uniform on F_p x F_p, admissible support density about 1/8, is a DERIVATION and may not be presented as an experimental finding under any branch. L2 - whether the frozen deterministic factor base produces fibre invariants distinguishable from a uniformly random 512-point factor base under the identical map and enumeration - is the measurement. L3 - whether the half-tuple dependency structure moves the statistic - is instrument characterization.
